name: CI-DELL Plastics, Inc.
old_description: People come to us for precision thermoset molding and machining.
about:
CI-Dell Plastics, Inc. is based in Mequon, Wisconsin. Founded by Ken Cihlar, the company has spent nearly 40 years specializing in precision thermoset molding and machining.

The shop offers a range of thermoset capabilities including compression and injection molding of phenolic, polyester, bulk molding compound (BMC), and sheet molding compound (SMC) materials. It also provides in-house tool room services, CNC machining of plastics, preforming, pelletizing, assembly, kitting, and plaque production.

CI-Dell serves the automotive industry with components such as valve covers, headlight liners, ignition parts, caps, and housings. It also supplies parts for small and major appliances, electrical components, and has had its specifications approved by the U.S. Department of Defense for use by the Army, Navy, and Air Force.

The company emphasizes operational excellence through teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement, backed by ISO 9001:2015 certification and individual employee certifications. Its approach centers on personal collaboration, creative problem-solving, and a commitment to on-time delivery.
